intentions.title: Make documentation citations self-verifying against ground truth (paths, symbols, routes, linerefs, commands) instead of trusting hand-maintained prose
intentions.evidence: verify-docs.mjs extracts TYPED CLAIMS from markdown backtick spans and code doc-comments, then verifies each against the on-disk tree, symbol-graph (symbols.json), and router.ex; turns 'the one-time 22-agent doc audit into a repeatable tool' (file header).

intentions.title: Never cry wolf: every candidate false/stale citation must survive an independent RE-VERIFY GATE before becoming a finding, with low-confidence leads routed to a human-review queue instead of auto-flagged
intentions.evidence: verify-docs.mjs `reverify()` re-runs path/lineref checks independently before emission; header cites the js-tests.yml false-flag regression the gate was built to prevent; acceptance-code-comments.mjs asserts a clean control file emits ZERO findings ('NEVER CRY WOLF' check b).

intentions.title: Extend citation truth-checking from markdown docs into code doc-comments (@moduledoc/@doc, //, /** */), since 27 of 29 known citation-truth defects lived in comment prose the markdown-only extractor never read
intentions.evidence: verify-docs.mjs extractCommentSpans/extractCommentClaims + langFor(elixir/go/ts); acceptance-code-comments.mjs proves fail-before on 29 frozen defects, pass-after on the fixed live tree, and catches planted stale linerefs/dead-tech assertions.

intentions.title: Catch prose that still asserts a gutted/retired dependency is live (e.g. claiming the graph pane 'uses Cytoscape' after it was replaced by a Canvas2D renderer, or citing the retired bin/bd-shim as an existing binary)
intentions.evidence: retired-terms.mjs is a context-aware denylist distinguishing live-use assertions from negated/historical mentions via NEG_BROAD/NEG_DEATH windows and doc-truth-allow pragmas; scanCorpus() enforces a never-worse gate over the live tree.

intentions.title: Guard against hand-maintained documentation enumerations (CLI HANDBOOK, cheatsheet, SDK README) silently falling behind the manifest-driven command/method surface as features ship
intentions.evidence: surface-parity.mjs cross-checks capabilities.ex ops against docs/cli/HANDBOOK.md + bp.md cheatsheet, and @barkpark/core's BarkparkClient interface + VALID_OPS filter operators against the package README; cites PRs #363/#364/#367 as the recurring drift class this automates.

intentions.title: Keep live-computed metrics (Cody quality-report scores, critic count, overall grade) from silently rotting in README prose after every recompute
intentions.evidence: metric-currency.mjs diffs the README '## Codebase grade' section against quality-report.json (per-critic scores, N/100 overall, N-critic count claim) and offers `--fix` to regenerate the table from the live report rather than hand-edit it.

intentions.title: Build a capstone pipeline (P1-P5: verify-docs → waterfall → highways → priority → remake) so a doc restructure can be gated on 'loses no verifiable fact, no outbound link, no reachable heading' rather than reviewed by eyeball
intentions.evidence: remake.mjs composes extractClaims/factKeyForClaim/runHighways into a CLAIM DIFF + LINK CHECK + STRUCTURE gate that auto-applies prose-only remakes and routes destructive merges/splits to human review; waterfall.mjs (P2) detects duplicate facts via Jaccard similarity over verifiable claim anchors, never prose similarity.
